clue.text: Worked vigorously to get money when broke

definitions.meaning: read literally, beaten with a strap in return for money, as though whipped into earning

explanation.surface: Someone toiled hard for pay because they had run out of funds.
explanation.definitionFit: Being short of funds is the idiom's everyday sense, so it matches penniless.

clue.text: Disabled office worker?

parts.note: read as someone short of a hand, yet really a clerk who takes dictation in quick symbols and keys it up

explanation.definitionFit: A clerk skilled in speedwriting and keyboard work, with a pun on being short-handed.

clue.text: Proportion of endless daily allowance

indicators.note: without an end, so the final letter of the allowance word is dropped

parts.note: a ration is a fixed daily allowance of food

explanation.surface: Someone asks what share of a daily allowance they are getting.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio expresses the relative size of two quantities, a proportion.

clue.text: Animal in part hidden by a wall

indicators.note: one word placed within the other, the animal sitting inside the part

parts.note: taken as written
an ape is an animal

explanation.surface: Some creature is partly concealed behind a wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden by a' is linking padding to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A parapet is a low protective wall along a roof edge or bridge.

clue.text: A beetle found under a silver coin in the country

indicators.note: in a down clue, the coin sits above, so the beetle comes after it

parts.note: the ecu was an old French silver coin
the dor is a dung beetle

explanation.surface: A beetle turns up beneath an old coin somewhere abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecuador is a South American nation, a country on the equator.

clue.text: A sweet and very affectionate little creature

parts.note: fond means loving or very affectionate
an ant is a tiny insect

explanation.surface: Something sugary and a loving little animal are described together.
explanation.definitionFit: Fondant is a soft creamy confection, a kind of sweet.

clue.text: Pity about rebel leader in some confusion

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: jumbled up, so the letters of the rebel's first letter and some are rearranged
jumbled up, so the letters of the rebel's first letter and some are rearranged
the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the first letter of rebel
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone feels sorry about a muddled rebel chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pity' is a loose definition, as in 'more's the pity'; 'in confusion' mixes the rebel's first letter with 'some', and RE (about) goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse is regret or sorrow felt, as in the phrase more's the pity.

clue.text: With skill I suppress the thistle-like plant

parts.note: art means skill or craft
to choke is to stifle or suppress

explanation.surface: A gardener skilfully smothers a prickly weed.
explanation.definitionFit: The globe vegetable is a thistle relative eaten for its fleshy bracts.

clue.text: An illegal strike

parts.note: not industrial action but a boxing punch landing too low to be allowed

explanation.definitionFit: In boxing a punch below the waistline is a foul, so an unfair blow.

clue.text: Animal by the stream in Northumberland

parts.note: an otter is a river animal
a burn is a Scottish and northern English word for a stream

explanation.surface: A creature lives beside a brook in the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A village in that English county, site of a famous fourteenth-century battle.

clue.text: Choral composition somehow to have been encountered going round

indicators.note: the encountered word goes around the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: met means encountered

indicators.note: done in some way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A choir piece is somehow met on a tour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges the two letters of 'to', and 'going round' means the meeting word wraps around them.
explanation.definitionFit: A motet is a short sacred piece for a choir.

clue.text: Went off round to Pedro

indicators.note: turned around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone headed off to visit Pedro.
explanation.definitionFit: To troop is to march away in a group, as in trooped off.

clue.text: A curl I disentangled on ear initially with earpiece!

indicators.note: untangled and so rearranged into a new order
the starting letter of ear is taken

explanation.surface: A hairdresser untangles a curl near an ear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disentangled' turns A CURL I into AURICL, then E from ear.
explanation.definitionFit: The auricle is the outer ear, the external flap.

clue.text: Have to admit

explanation.definitionFit: Owning is possessing; to own up is to confess.

clue.text: Showmen I'm going before with an eastern garment

parts.note: pre is a prefix meaning before
a sari is a draped Indian garment

explanation.surface: A performer boasts of arriving first in an oriental robe.
explanation.definitionFit: Impresarios are theatrical producers and promoters, showmen.

clue.text: It's strange, with son having a better than even chance

indicators.note: the answer is what remains of the odds phrase when the son is taken from it

parts.note: odds-on describes something more likely than not
taken as written

explanation.surface: A father thinks it odd that his boy is a likely winner.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads backwards: the answer with SON added makes ODDS-ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Odd means peculiar or unusual.

clue.text: The Spanish motor could have produced a quivering effect

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A Spanish engine might make things shudder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could have produced' shuffles EL plus MOTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a wavering musical effect, rapid repetition of a note.

clue.text: Growth of repentance

definitions.meaning: a plant, the bitter herb of that name

explanation.definitionFit: Rue is a herb and also regret.

clue.text: Relies on oriental leaving parts of swimming-pools

indicators.note: the eastern letter departs from the pool parts

parts.note: deep ends are parts of swimming pools
E stands for east, oriental

explanation.surface: Someone trusts an Easterner to leave the deep end.
explanation.definitionFit: Depends on means relies on.

clue.text: Naturally loses conscious ness

parts.note: a natural blackout: not fainting but simply drifting into sleep

explanation.definitionFit: To doze off is to fall asleep without any outside cause.

clue.text: Races about with an unruly Arab

indicators.note: disorderly, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A wild Arab horseman races about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about with' is padding around the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Saracen was a medieval name for an Arab or Muslim.

clue.text: Present another treacherous person

indicators.note: a different version of the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone presents another traitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A serpent figuratively is a sly, treacherous person, like the snake in Eden.

clue.text: Dam loyal

definitions.meaning: to stop a flow, as of blood

explanation.definitionFit: To staunch is to stem a flow; staunch also means steadfast.

clue.text: Stop the chorus

definitions.meaning: a repeated part of a song

explanation.definitionFit: Refraining is holding back; a refrain is a repeated verse line.

clue.text: Mainly behind

parts.note: the main is the sea, so this means at the rear in seafaring terms

explanation.definitionFit: A nautical word for towards the stern of a ship.

clue.text: One submitting produce hesitantly

parts.note: to yield is to produce
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone gives in while producing nervously.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who gives way or submits.

clue.text: A couple of fellows are talented and easily approached

parts.note: F is fellow, so two of them
able means talented

explanation.surface: A pair of men are gifted and friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: Affable means friendly and approachable.

clue.text: Ask about in person

indicators.note: around, so the asking word surrounds the other

parts.note: to beg is to ask

explanation.surface: Someone requests something in person.
explanation.definitionFit: A being is a living creature, a person.

clue.text: One metre past, it is as far as a moth can go

definitions.text: it is as far as a moth can go

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: A moth flutters one metre, its furthest flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The imago is the final adult stage of an insect's development.

clue.text: I be at clan gathering where the music is flowing and melodious

indicators.note: brought together in a jumble, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone attends a clan meeting with lovely music.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction for smooth, songlike playing.

clue.text: Stealthy intruder not guilty of daylight robbery!

definitions.text: Stealthy intruder not guilty of daylight robbery!

parts.words: Stealthy intruder not guilty of daylight robbery!
parts.note: a burglar who works only in darkness, so cannot commit theft by day

explanation.definitionFit: A biblical phrase for one coming unexpectedly, literally a burglar operating after dark.
